note: pg_policies + pg_tables.rowsecurity export via Supabase CLI, synthetic training data

tables.finding: RLS never enabled on this table since it was scaffolded by Lovable. Anyone with the anon key (public, ships in every client bundle by design) can SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE every row.

policies.finding: RLS is technically enabled, but the policy expression is literally `true` — it matches every row for every requester, same practical effect as no RLS at all. Looks fixed in a schema diff; isn't.

policies.qual: auth.uid() = author_id OR org_id = (select org_id from memberships where user_id = auth.uid())
policies.finding: Correctly scoped — added by the founder after a security blog post scared them into fixing at least one table. customers and tickets were never revisited.
